requirement: NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE as a universal rule: the rulebooks do not universally require scratched or no-show entries to be excluded without placement. Exclusion without automatic last place is DanceFlow Studio policy (R08-DF-0001), never presented as a governing-body requirement.
interpretation_notes: Bodies differ: UCWDC disqualifies from the dance category (R08-UCWDC-0001/0002); NDCA III.D.30 awards last place for dances not performed after a qualifying withdrawal (OD08-NDCA-0001, PR 840). NDCA V.B.2 (competitor attends one-half hour in advance; organizers need not delay for latecomers; PDF p.38) is context only.
